messages:
Samir Gupta: Quick sync on model catalog view-presets, compact-compare, and pin/unpin messaging. Posting mock links: https://redwood.mock/ux/views-v2 :mag:
Samir Gupta: Main asks: let users save 'views' (filters + column layout), compact compare with column pinning, performance badge needs numeric sparkline option, and pin modal + short undo toast copy.
Nora Li: Love the 'view' naming. Suggest adding a folder/tag system for org-wide vs personal views. Maybe prefix with icons: 🔒 for private, 🏷️ for org.
Priya Singh: Copy for save action: 'Save view' + small input for name. Secondary text: 'Includes filters, columns, and sort order'. Keep straightforward.
Diego Morales: On compact compare: allow column pinning (user pins a metric column so it stays visible while scrolling) and a horizontal condensed row mode. Keyboard: use 'v' to toggle compare mode, 'c' to pin/unpin column when focused.
Nora Li: Accessibility: condensed mode should respect reduced-motion and respect system font size. If condensed means <12px then we should avoid; instead collapse padding not font.
Priya Singh: Perf badge: current colored dot isn't scannable. Proposal: show tiny inline sparkline + p95 as number. Tooltip: 'p50 28ms · p95 120ms · cost 0.9x'. For colorblind, add patterned background or an adjacent small letter grade (A/B/C).
Samir Gupta: Good. For sparkline we need tiny SVG with aria-hidden and an accessible alt text in tooltip.
Diego Morales: Dev note: sparklines increase render cost in big lists. We should lazy-render in viewport or on hover. Could also offer a compact list toggle to disable sparklines.
Nora Li: Presets/views shareability: map view id in URL like `?view=org-ml-team/qa` and support copying link from the view menu. Add 'Make default view' action.
Priya Singh: Version pin modal copy feels scary. Current text: 'Are you sure you want to pin?'. Suggest: primary heading 'Pin model version to production', body 'Routing will send traffic to this version. You can unpin anytime. A summary of changes is below.' Checkbox: 'Notify team via Slack' default off.
Samir Gupta: Also include a small diff table in the modal: hash, params changed, quantization, and last eval score. That helps reviewers decide quickly.
Diego Morales: For unpin/undo UX, propose a toast: 'Pinned model x.y.z to production. Undo' where Undo reverts in 15s. If they click undo, show ephemeral confirmation and log event.
Nora Li: Accessibility for modal: focus trap, initial focus on 'Pin' button, and announce via aria-live: 'Model pinned successfully' or 'Failed to pin' with error reason.
Priya Singh: Microcopy on the toast: keep it short. 'Pinned v2.3 — Undo'. Avoid 'success' verbosity.
Samir Gupta: Edge case: if pin leads to traffic shift, maybe warn when traffic >50% change. Add a subtle yellow warning row in modal.
Diego Morales: Implementation estimate: view-presets + URL mapping = 3 dev days. Compact compare + column pin = 4 dev days. Sparklines lazy render + toggle = 2 dev days. Modal + toast + analytics hook = 1.5 dev days.
Nora Li: QA checklist suggestion: keyboard nav through view menu, announce view changes to screen readers, test pin modal on mobile widths, test toast focus order.
Priya Singh: Design tweaks I'll push: folder labels for views, small chevron on active view, condensed compare mock with pinned column sticky at left, sparklines variant, and updated modal copy. Will post Figma link in comments.
Samir Gupta: Can we add an ephemeral 'recently used views' section in the view switcher? Quick access for common workflows.
Priya Singh: Yes — we can show 4 recent and a 'manage views' action that opens the full picker.
a11y-bot: Reminder: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for actionable copy, skip-to-content link exists, and sparklines must not convey info by color alone.
Samir Gupta: Thanks all — follow-up review Friday 9:30am. If no objections I'll land the figma updates tonight and tag dev tickets.
